name: actual ASCII producer
body:
Lumen token bench: postponed audit disposition retain

For the Lumen token bench postponed audit marked with a diamond, the operator must retain the marked audit card in the station folder.

This is a fictional current instruction for a very narrow audit state. A postponed audit means an audit whose appointment was canceled before inspection. The diamond is a mark on its audit cover card, not an ordinary batch identifier. An unflagged ordinary run remains governed by the operation note and its complete procedure. Nothing in this instruction changes owner assignments, consultation windows, session start, session duration, or ordinary allocation.

The decision here concerns the marked audit card only. It does not describe treatment of samples, equipment, session cards, or records belonging to a completed ordinary run. Before selecting any disposition, the operator identifies the card as a postponed audit and confirms the diamond on its cover. Cards without that combination do not fall within this instruction's condition.

This document is published as a current authority for its stated condition. It has no precedence over another current document in the same curated conflict group. The grouping deliberately preserves an unresolved policy disagreement about the disposition. A reader must not invent a recency ranking from the title or choose one action because it appears convenient. Resolution requires a later authoritative revision that is not present in this corpus.

name: BOM gap is not Python whitespace
body:
Lumen token bench: postponed audit disposition retain
﻿
For the Lumen token bench postponed audit marked with a diamond, the operator must retain the marked audit card in the station folder.

This is a fictional current instruction for a very narrow audit state. A postponed audit means an audit whose appointment was canceled before inspection. The diamond is a mark on its audit cover card, not an ordinary batch identifier. An unflagged ordinary run remains governed by the operation note and its complete procedure. Nothing in this instruction changes owner assignments, consultation windows, session start, session duration, or ordinary allocation.

The decision here concerns the marked audit card only. It does not describe treatment of samples, equipment, session cards, or records belonging to a completed ordinary run. Before selecting any disposition, the operator identifies the card as a postponed audit and confirms the diamond on its cover. Cards without that combination do not fall within this instruction's condition.
